result.prior_version_note: Just cause was previously called 'good cause'. Before Measure BB (passed in the November 2024 election), landlords could evict for nonpayment of rental debt below one month's Fair Market Rent and for failure to sign a new fixed-term lease. Lease-breach evictions did not require actual harm. Owner move-in relocation adjustments were not mandatory, and filing of eviction notices within three business days was not required. The documents give no date for when the just cause ordinance first applied or when Measure BB took effect. Component dates: the Notice of Tenant Rights applies to tenancies starting on or after December 20, 2024, and the current relocation amounts took effect January 1, 2026.
